items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: there was a Mrs. Hightower, she was the president of the union... and she helped me a lot and introduced me to Lil Armstrong

ctx.x: And I managed to get -- through the union there was a Mrs. Hightower, she was the president of the union, then, the secretary of the union, and she helped me a lot and introduced me to Lil Armstrong and I went out with Lil Armstrong and made some gigs with her.
